name: Django
subtitle: Batteries-included Python framework
creator: Adrian Holovaty and Simon Willison
description: A full-stack Python framework with an ORM, migrations, an automatic admin panel, authentication, forms, templates and security protections built in. It was created at a newspaper to ship features fast, and Django 6 added built-in background tasks and native Content Security Policy support.
useCases: REST APIs via Django REST Framework

languages.youWrite: Python plus the Django template language

concepts.explanation: Python classes map to database tables.
Auto-generated back office from your models.
Background work API added in Django 6.

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
# models.py
from django.db import models

class Article(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    published = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

# views.py
from django.shortcuts import render
from .models import Article

def article_list(request):
    articles = Article.objects.order_by("-published")[:10]
    return render(request, "articles/list.html", {"articles": articles})

pros: Access to Python's data and AI ecosystem
cons: Async support in the ORM is still partial
Templates feel dated for rich UIs
Needs a server host, not a static or edge platform
